Previous user message =turnCount-1. Previous assistant answer =lastAnswerIndex. historyPart=user for what user said, assistant for a previous answer. Example: asking for code in FIRST user message => action recall, historyIndex0, historyPart user, query empty. Save last answer => capture, historyIndex lastAnswerIndex, historyPart assistant. Otherwise historyIndex=null. Never search notes for a dialogue-only request. Use user language.
